subject: Phase 1: Project scaffold & config
description: Set up project structure, package.json with all deps, tsconfig, env schema, Docker, ESLint/Prettier,

subject: Phase 2: Database layer (Prisma)
description: Prisma schema for all entities, migrations, seed data, soft-delete, audit trails, optimized indexes

subject: Phase 3: Core infrastructure
description: Express server, error handling, response formatting, request ID, logging, graceful shutdown, health

subject: Phase 4: Auth & RBAC system
description: JWT access/refresh tokens, bcrypt, RBAC middleware, account lockout, 2FA, session management

subject: Phase 5: API modules (v1)
description: All REST API routes: auth, users, workspaces, teams, projects, tasks, notifications, files, activity

subject: Phase 6: Performance & caching
description: Redis caching, response compression, BullMQ jobs, connection pooling, API response caching

subject: Phase 7: Security hardening
description: Helmet, CORS, rate limiting, CSRF, input sanitization, XSS/SQL injection protection, IP whitelisting

subject: Phase 8: Docs, testing, DX
description: Swagger/OpenAPI, Postman collection, test suite, structured logging, error tracking

subject: Phase 9: Deployment & infrastructure
description: Docker Compose production, Nginx reverse proxy, CI/CD GitHub Actions, PM2, monitoring, SSL, backups
